column2: [intro]
I am the king of procrastination,
I push everything to the last occasion.
I prefer to stay flexible, with no commitment,
The world is my playground, pure amusement.
I’m always indecisive, I love surprise,
No need to decide, it keeps me at ease.
I float in uncertainty, in the unforeseen,
I like to keep all options, even after midnight.
I struggle to choose just one direction,
I’d rather explore all options with affection.
I’m an adventurer of the unpredictable,
Every moment is a surprise, a treasure indescribable.
Always indecisive, that’s my identity,
I enjoy each moment, it’s my liberty.
No need to plan or organize,
I’m free as the air, it’s my favorite prize.
[ solo ]
I’m always indecisive, I love surprise,
No need to decide, it keeps me at ease.
I float in uncertainty, in the unforeseen,
I like to keep all options, even after midnight.
[outro]
